reason_for_induction: Formalization of the E component in RT/Core and the realization aspect of the primary biconditional.
proposed_definition: The realization aspect of the mono-process. Formally represents discrete actualization or selection within the admissibility domain, maintaining a non-collapse relational tension with Affect ($A$) via the relation $A \langle\neq\rangle E$.
process_rewrite: Effect and Affect are inseparable aspect-positions of the mono-process. Effect is the realization aspect; Affect is the necessity aspect.

proposed_roles.operational_definition: Functions as the 'Discrete Realization' or 'Actualization' side of the primary axiom, establishing the selection result within the admissibility window.
proposed_roles.falsification_condition: discrete realization can be reduced to continuous transport or residue without remainder
